## SK Hynix ADR strength drives won-yen divergence as dollar flows into South Korea

Currency divergence traceable to SK Hynix ADR flows is a second-order read on HBM conviction — institutional money is moving at the macro level, not just the single-stock level. Reinforces the view that HBM leadership is being priced as structural, not cyclical.

- SK Hynix's ADR is performing strongly enough to pull dollar inflows into South Korea.
- Won (KRW) and yen (JPY) are diverging, attributed directly to this dynamic in the headline.
- HBM demand momentum is registering not just in equity prices but in cross-border capital flows.
- The divergence signals a Korea-over-Japan preference in memory at the macro-allocation level.
